data.change_summary: Denitrification in suboxic substrate zones is fully implemented across all touch points. The nitrogen_cycle.rs system includes a complete denitrification step (step 5) using dual Monod kinetics on NO3 and DOC concentrations estimated from water-column values via a pore-water mixing factor. The rate formula is: vmax × activity_index × monod(NO3_pore, K_no3) × monod(DOC_pore, K_doc) × suboxic_pore_volume_l × temperature_factor. NO3 consumed is removed as N2 gas (permanent export tracked in cumulative_n2_export_mg_n), DOC is consumed stoichiometrically (5/4 × 12/14.007 mg C per mg N), DIC is produced (carbon conserved), and alkalinity is produced (DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N = 1/14.007 meq per mg N). All five named parameters (vmax, K_no3, K_doc, mixing_factor, maturation_days) are in ProcessParams with serde defaults and default.toml entries. The denitrifier_activity_index in MicrobeState ramps from 0→1 over configurable maturation days via update_daily_denitrifier_activity(). N2 export is tracked as an explicit budget component in the nitrogen budget ledger. 12 tests cover all acceptance criteria including unit tests for NO3 removal, DOC requirement, suboxic volume scaling, alkalinity production, stoichiometry, Monod concentration-based kinetics, budget export tracking, negligible rate in oxic substrate, and integration tests for nitrate accumulation reduction and activity ramp.
outstanding_risks: The pore-water mixing factor (0.5) is a simplification — real pore-water concentrations depend on diffusion gradients, substrate flow, and depth. Future refinement could model a concentration gradient rather than a fixed fraction.

The activity maturation ramp uses exponential approach without explicit denitrifier biomass tracking — if more detailed denitrifier ecology is needed (e.g., competition with sulfate reducers), the model would need extension.
The DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N constant comment still says 'Reserved for E4b' — this is a stale doc comment that should be updated to reflect implementation status.
Downstream bead tanksim-6e5.7.2 (provenance/confidence metadata) will need to annotate the denitrification parameter confidence levels and literature sources.

steps.description: Add denitrification stoichiometric constants to process.rs (DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N, DENITRIFICATION_DOC_MG_C_PER_MG_N)
Add denitrification named parameters to ProcessParams struct (vmax, K_no3, K_doc, mixing_factor, maturation_days) with serde defaults
Add default parameter values to crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml (denitrification section with literature-sourced values)
Add denitrifier_activity_index field to MicrobeState in biology.rs
Add cumulative_n2_export_mg_n field to TankState for permanent N export tracking
Add cumulative_n2_export_mg_n as a budget component in nitrogen_budget_components() in budget.rs

Implement denitrification step in step_nitrogen_cycle() with dual Monod kinetics (NO3 + DOC), suboxic pore volume scaling, activity index, temperature factor, stoichiometric DOC consumption, DIC production, and alkalinity production
Wire denitrification alkalinity production into alkalinity accounting (same pathway as D4.7 nitrification consumption)
Add denitrification output fields to NitrogenCycleOutput (n2_export, doc_consumed, alkalinity_produced)
Implement update_daily_denitrifier_activity() for exponential maturation ramp (0→1 over configurable days, decays if no suboxic zone)
Wire denitrification metrics into engine budget ledger (denitrification_n2_export_mg_n, alkalinity_produced_meq)
Unit test: test_denitrification_removes_no3 — suboxic zone with high NO3 and DOC yields measurable N removal
Unit test: test_denitrification_requires_no3 — zero NO3 yields zero denitrification
Unit test: test_denitrification_requires_doc — zero DOC yields negligible denitrification
Unit test: test_denitrification_rate_scales_with_suboxic_volume — larger suboxic zone yields proportionally higher rate
Unit test: test_denitrification_produces_alkalinity — alkalinity matches DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N × mg_N_denitrified
Unit test: test_denitrification_tracked_as_export — N2 export appears as explicit budget component, not unexplained loss
Unit test: test_denitrification_negligible_when_fully_oxic — fully oxic substrate yields zero denitrification
Unit test: test_denitrification_monod_concentration_based — rate depends on concentrations with sub-linear Monod saturation
Unit test: test_denitrification_stoichiometry — DOC consumed and alkalinity produced match stoichiometric ratios within 1e-6
Unit test: test_denitrification_rate_scales_with_doc — higher DOC yields higher denitrification rate
Integration test: test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation — 500h simulation shows lower NO3 with active denitrification vs disabled
Integration test: test_denitrification_activity_ramp — fresh substrate starts with minimal activity, increases over weeks to near 1.0
Validate: cargo test --test denitrification (12/12 pass), cargo clippy -- -D warnings (clean), cargo fmt --check (clean)

validation_evidence: cargo test --test denitrification: 12 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored (all unit and integration tests pass)
cargo clippy -- -D warnings: clean, no warnings or errors across entire workspace
cargo fmt --check: clean, all code properly formatted
test_denitrification_removes_no3: NO3 decreases measurably, output.denitrification_n2_export_mg_n matches actual decrease within 1e-9
test_denitrification_requires_doc: zero DOC yields export < 0.001 (negligible trace from biomass decay routing)
test_denitrification_rate_scales_with_suboxic_volume: 7cm suboxic zone yields >1.5x rate vs 1cm suboxic zone
test_denitrification_produces_alkalinity: alkalinity_produced_meq matches n_denitrified × DENITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N within 1e-6
test_denitrification_tracked_as_export: cumulative_n2_export_mg_n increases, total N (including export counter) conserved within 1e-6, budget metric appears in ledger
test_denitrification_monod_concentration_based: 40 mg/L NO3 vs 1 mg/L shows higher rate but sub-linear (ratio < 5.0, confirming saturation kinetics)
test_denitrification_stoichiometry: DOC consumed and alkalinity produced match stoichiometric constants within 1e-6
test_denitrification_rate_scales_with_doc: higher DOC yields higher denitrification rate
test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation: 500h integration — tank with denitrifier activity=0.8 has lower NO3 than activity=0.0, cumulative N2 export > 0.01
test_denitrification_activity_ramp: day 1 activity in (0, 0.1), day 30 > 0.2, day 120 > 0.8; mature activity (1.0) yields >2x rate vs fresh (0.1)
